en.title: Dave Bautista's God of War Transformation Is Just Getting Started
en.summary: The actor is deep into his physical prep for Kratos, sharing glimpses of his intense training. With filming set to resume, the pressure is on for Bautista to embody the Ghost of Sparta.
en.body:
The gears are turning for Amazon Prime Video's **God of War** series, and **Dave Bautista** is already putting in the work to become the Ghost of Sparta. The former WWE superstar and current action hero has been documenting his rigorous transformation for the iconic role, revealing that he's deep into a muscle-building regimen that will take months to perfect.

Bautista officially stepped into Kratos's massive boots earlier this year, taking over the part after **Ryan Hurst** suffered an injury during production. Hurst, who was originally cast, tore his bicep, necessitating surgery and a recasting. This change means Bautista has a tight timeline to achieve the god-like physique required for the character. He recently shared a video showcasing his progress, indicating that while he's made significant gains, there are still "two more months to get to where I need to be." This dedication highlights the immense physical challenge of portraying Kratos, a character known for his brutal strength and imposing presence in the critically acclaimed video game franchise.

## The Weight of the Blades

The stakes for **Dave Bautista** are incredibly high. **God of War** is one of PlayStation's most revered properties, and fans have been eagerly awaiting a faithful adaptation. The pressure to deliver a Kratos that satisfies both long-time gamers and new viewers is immense. Bautista, known for his own physicality in roles like Drax the Destroyer in the Marvel Cinematic Universe, seems to be embracing the challenge head-on. His commitment to a serious body transformation, rather than relying on prosthetics or CGI alone, signals a deep respect for the source material and a desire to embody the character authentically. The news of his continued training, coupled with the confirmed restart of production, fuels anticipation and debate within the fanbase about how this new iteration of Kratos will be portrayed.

## What's Next for the God of War

With **Dave Bautista** pushing his physical limits, the **God of War** series is gearing up for a production restart. Filming is expected to resume around early November 2026. This gives Bautista roughly two more months of intense training and preparation to reach his final form as Kratos. Fans will be watching his social media closely for further updates on his transformation, eager to see the Ghost of Sparta finally take shape on screen.

content_raw: Dave Bautista is preparing to star as Kratos in the God of War TV series on Prime Video, and he took to Instagram to show off his training physique.
